# The relations of the places, read in context

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`place-relations-in-context` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](place-relations-in-context.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> The relations of a hexagram's places, 正, 應, 比 and 中, are readings in context: they glue to a reading of the whole only where every site agrees, the trigrams exactly where no height is opposed. Along every run, opposition is told by phase; the oppositions carry waxing and waning, the phases do not.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A hexagram has three heights in each of two trigrams, each place being one height of one trigram, and two adjacent places meet at a seam; the places alternate in parity across every seam. (`Becoming.Hexagram.Height`, `Becoming.Hexagram.Half`, `Becoming.Hexagram.place`, `Becoming.Hexagram.heightOf`, `Becoming.Hexagram.Seam`, `Becoming.Hexagram.below`, `Becoming.Hexagram.above`, `Becoming.Hexagram.Seam.next`, `Becoming.Hexagram.Place.mirror`, `Becoming.Hexagram.Height.mirror`, `Becoming.Hexagram.Seam.mirror`, `Becoming.Hexagram.odd`, `Becoming.Hexagram.odd_above`)
2. A line is in phase where its value is its place's parity (正); the two lines at one height are opposed where they differ (應); adjacent lines alternate, rise or fall across their seam (比, 承, 乘); the middle height is lines 2 and 5 (中). Rises and the bottom line count as many as falls and the top line. (`Becoming.Hexagram.inPhase`, `Becoming.Hexagram.opposed`, `Becoming.Hexagram.alternates`, `Becoming.Hexagram.rises`, `Becoming.Hexagram.falls`, `Becoming.Hexagram.middle`, `Becoming.Hexagram.phaseCount`, `Becoming.Hexagram.riseCount`, `Becoming.Hexagram.fallCount`, `Becoming.Hexagram.rises_falls_ends`)
3. A relation read at each of its sites is a contextual reading of the configuration, gluing to one reading of the whole exactly where every site shows the same. The two trigrams read as contexts glue exactly where no height is opposed, so no frame of context-free claims fits the heights under any process, while the indexed frame fits. (`Becoming.Hexagram.atSites`, `Becoming.Hexagram.atSites_glues_iff`, `Becoming.Hexagram.atSites_glues_iff_constant`, `Becoming.Hexagram.halves`, `Becoming.Hexagram.halves_indexed`, `Becoming.Hexagram.eq_iff_not_same`, `Becoming.Hexagram.halves_agree_at`, `Becoming.Hexagram.halves_glues_iff`, `Becoming.Hexagram.halves_no_free_frame`)
4. The phases glue exactly at 既濟 and 未濟, every line in phase or none; the oppositions where every height or none is opposed; the seams exactly at 乾, 坤, 既濟 and 未濟. So no frame of context-free claims fits the phases, the oppositions or the alternations under any process, while the indexed frame fits. (`Becoming.Hexagram.jiJi_inPhase`, `Becoming.Hexagram.weiJi_out_of_phase`, `Becoming.Hexagram.inPhase_all_iff`, `Becoming.Hexagram.inPhase_none_iff`, `Becoming.Hexagram.phases_glue_iff`, `Becoming.Hexagram.oppositions_glue_iff`, `Becoming.Hexagram.alternates_all_iff`, `Becoming.Hexagram.alternates_none_iff`, `Becoming.Hexagram.seams_glue_iff`, `Becoming.Hexagram.atSites_indexed`, `Becoming.Hexagram.phases_no_free_frame`, `Becoming.Hexagram.oppositions_no_free_frame`, `Becoming.Hexagram.seams_no_free_frame`)
5. The lines at a height are opposed exactly where both or neither are in phase; so both middle lines in phase give the middle opposed, and every line out of phase, or every line in phase, gives every height opposed. An unbroken and a broken middle line with an answer pick out the same configurations. (`Becoming.Hexagram.opposed_iff_phase`, `Becoming.Hexagram.middle_phase_opposed`, `Becoming.Hexagram.out_of_phase_opposed`, `Becoming.Hexagram.in_phase_opposed`, `Becoming.Hexagram.middleUnbrokenOpposed`, `Becoming.Hexagram.middleBrokenOpposed`, `Becoming.Hexagram.middleUnbrokenOpposed_eq`, `Becoming.Hexagram.middleBrokenOpposed_eq`)
6. The complement turns every phase, so the counts in phase of a configuration and its complement add to six, keeps every opposition and alternation, and exchanges rises and falls; turning over does the same at the mirrored site. (`Becoming.Hexagram.same_not_left`, `Becoming.Hexagram.same_not_not`, `Becoming.Hexagram.line_complement`, `Becoming.Hexagram.inPhase_complement`, `Becoming.Hexagram.phaseCount_complement`, `Becoming.Hexagram.opposed_complement`, `Becoming.Hexagram.alternates_complement`, `Becoming.Hexagram.rises_complement`, `Becoming.Hexagram.line_reverse`, `Becoming.Hexagram.inPhase_reverse`, `Becoming.Hexagram.phaseCount_reverse`, `Becoming.Hexagram.opposed_reverse`, `Becoming.Hexagram.rises_reverse`)
7. Changing the line at a place turns its phase and the opposition at its height and leaves every other place and height as it was; the count in phase moves by one. (`Becoming.Hexagram.line_flip_self`, `Becoming.Hexagram.line_flip_other`, `Becoming.Hexagram.inPhase_flip_self`, `Becoming.Hexagram.inPhase_flip_other`, `Becoming.Hexagram.phaseCount_flip`, `Becoming.Hexagram.opposed_flip_self`, `Becoming.Hexagram.opposed_flip_other`)
8. Under the law of waxing and waning each line rises with its value, so its phase turns at every rise and is kept only where the top line enters at the bottom; the counts in phase before and after a step add to five or seven, so the count changes parity at every step, 3, 2, 3, 2, 3, 2, 3, 4, 3, 4, 3, 4 from 乾, and is not a lumping the law goes alike across. Alternations, rises and falls travel with their lines. (`Becoming.Hexagram.line_waxWane_above`, `Becoming.Hexagram.same_not_right`, `Becoming.Hexagram.inPhase_waxWane_above`, `Becoming.Hexagram.inPhase_waxWane_bottom`, `Becoming.Hexagram.phaseCount_waxWane`, `Becoming.Hexagram.phaseCount_parity`, `Becoming.Hexagram.phase_parity_along_run`, `Becoming.Hexagram.phase_qian_orbit`, `Becoming.Hexagram.phaseCount_not_lumped`, `Becoming.Hexagram.phaseCount_not_goAlike`, `Becoming.Hexagram.alternates_carried`, `Becoming.Hexagram.rises_carried`, `Becoming.Hexagram.falls_carried`)
9. The oppositions of the three heights run under the law of waxing and waning on three cells, so they are a lumping the law goes alike across: three steps turn every opposition and six keep it; two patterns return at the second step, and the other six form one cycle of six steps through every height opposed and none. The doubled trigrams are three steps from opposition at every height. (`Becoming.Hexagram.opposition`, `Becoming.Hexagram.waxWane3`, `Becoming.Hexagram.opposition_waxWane`, `Becoming.Hexagram.opposition_lumped`, `Becoming.Hexagram.opposition_goAlike`, `Becoming.Hexagram.opposed_three_steps`, `Becoming.Hexagram.opposition_six`, `Becoming.Hexagram.waxWane3_twice_iff`, `Becoming.Hexagram.waxWane3_moves`, `Becoming.Hexagram.opposition_cycle`, `Becoming.Hexagram.opposition_two_iff`, `Becoming.Hexagram.halves_glue_three`)
10. Along every run of waxing and waning, each line's phase turns as it rises, the counts in phase at consecutive steps add to five or seven, and alternations travel with their lines; six steps on every phase is turned and, opposition being told by phase, every opposition kept; three steps on every opposition is turned; the pattern of oppositions changes at every step and, from every height opposed, goes round in six. (`Becoming.Hexagram.run_phase_rises`, `Becoming.Hexagram.run_phase_enters`, `Becoming.Hexagram.run_phaseCount`, `Becoming.Hexagram.run_carried`, `Becoming.Hexagram.run_six_turns`, `Becoming.Hexagram.run_six_keeps`, `Becoming.Hexagram.run_three_turns`, `Becoming.Hexagram.run_doubled_three`, `Becoming.Hexagram.run_opposition_moves`, `Becoming.Hexagram.run_opposition_two_iff`, `Becoming.Hexagram.opposition_orbit`, `Becoming.Hexagram.map_agree`, `Becoming.Hexagram.run_opposition_cycle`)
11. Along every run of the change of one line, each step turns the phase of the line it changes and the opposition at its height and keeps every other; turned over, a run of waxing and waning is the run of the law backward from the turned-over configuration, on which every relation is mirrored; whatever a run of any process shows, opposition is told by phase. (`Becoming.Hexagram.changes_run_phase`, `Becoming.Hexagram.changes_run_opposition`, `Becoming.Hexagram.backward_run`, `Becoming.Hexagram.backward_relations`, `Becoming.Hexagram.shown_along_run`)
12. The configurations the passage map cites are named by their number in the received order, and what the 彖 and the 象 say of their places holds of them: 未濟, 恒 and 咸 opposed at every height, 艮's trigrams gluing, the second line of 同人, the fourth of 小畜 and the fifth of 大有, the falls of 歸妹 and 夬. (`Becoming.Hexagram.nth`, `Becoming.Hexagram.number`, `Becoming.Hexagram.xu`, `Becoming.Hexagram.xiaoXu`, `Becoming.Hexagram.tongRen`, `Becoming.Hexagram.daYou`, `Becoming.Hexagram.xian`, `Becoming.Hexagram.heng`, `Becoming.Hexagram.guai`, `Becoming.Hexagram.gen`, `Becoming.Hexagram.guiMei`, `Becoming.Hexagram.jiJi`, `Becoming.Hexagram.weiJi`, `Becoming.Hexagram.weiJi_opposed`, `Becoming.Hexagram.heng_opposed`, `Becoming.Hexagram.xian_opposed`, `Becoming.Hexagram.gen_halves_glue`, `Becoming.Hexagram.tongRen_second`, `Becoming.Hexagram.xiaoXu_fourth`, `Becoming.Hexagram.daYou_fifth`, `Becoming.Hexagram.guiMei_falls`, `Becoming.Hexagram.guai_falls`)
13. Four censuses list the explicit statements of a kind in the 彖 and the 小象, found in the preserved pages by the script: 26 statements of 位 agree with the parity of their places, 9 of 中正 are middle and in phase, 5 of 乘剛 are falls and 5 of 剛中而應 are the middle opposed; the two exceptions, 需's top line and 艮's fifth, are stated as they are. (`Becoming.Hexagram.placeStatements`, `Becoming.Hexagram.placesHold`, `Becoming.Hexagram.placesHold_sound`, `Becoming.Hexagram.placeStatements_agree`, `Becoming.Hexagram.xu_top_inPhase`, `Becoming.Hexagram.centreStatements`, `Becoming.Hexagram.centresHold`, `Becoming.Hexagram.centresHold_sound`, `Becoming.Hexagram.centreStatements_agree`, `Becoming.Hexagram.gen_fifth_out_of_phase`, `Becoming.Hexagram.fallStatements`, `Becoming.Hexagram.fallsHold`, `Becoming.Hexagram.fallsHold_sound`, `Becoming.Hexagram.fallStatements_agree`, `Becoming.Hexagram.middleOppositionStatements`, `Becoming.Hexagram.middleOppositionsHold`, `Becoming.Hexagram.middleOppositionsHold_sound`, `Becoming.Hexagram.middleOppositionStatements_agree`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom and no premise: the sites, relations, contextual readings and censuses are defined in the module; each spine law is used at its stated hypotheses (Contextual.fitsFree_iff with a height or a site as home; Learning.goAlike_iff_lumped at the oppositions and the count in phase); the laws along runs hold for every run of the named process, shown_along_run for every run of every process.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- What any passage says of the places beyond these relations; the passage map of the chapter states, passage by passage, agreement, exact scope or divergence, and its readings are the AI's.
- The ranks of the places (尊位, 貴賤); the reading with no fixed place at the bottom and top (初上无位), the line answered by all others (上下應之, 乘五剛), the censuses of the line texts and the 大象, and 王弼's 《周易略例》 are in fixed-places-and-sole-lines; the 文言's statements of place. The censuses of the sixty-four by each count, which the earlier repository states.
- That being in phase, opposed, central or rising is good, fortunate or supports 生生; the module has no ethical predicate and no judgment of fortune.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Continues hexagrams-on-the-spine (Y1), which listed the relations of the places as not done, on Ren's request of 19 October 2026, “我要你把这个系统完全建立起来，要变成库的一部分，要确保它在spine上有明确的mapping” (provenance, not warrant). The chapter on the 易传 maps 22 passages that cite this module: 12 agreements, 5 exact scopes and 5 divergences. Reading (the AI's, D50): 正 is a relation of a line and its place, so a line's phase turns as it rises (六位時成); 應 is told by phase, so 未濟's 雖不當位，剛柔應也 is an entailment; 敵應 is where the two trigrams glue; the oppositions carry the law and the count in phase does not; the text agrees with the relations in four censuses except at 需's top line and 艮's fifth; the ranks of the places diverge.

<a id="dependencies--依赖"></a>
### Dependencies

- **formal-reuse**: [hexagrams-on-the-spine](hexagrams-on-the-spine.md). Reuses the configurations, the received order, complement, reverse, flip and waxWane of Becoming.Hexagrams; the delta is the relations of the places read on them.
  - Output: Six two-valued lines, the received order holding every configuration, and the laws of change on them.
  - Input: Hexagram, line, same, order, complement, reverse, flip, waxWane, rising.
  - Preserved conditions: None. [Hexagrams.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Hexagrams.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [claims-shown-in-context](claims-shown-in-context.md). Reuses Contextual, Glues, indexed, indexed_fits, FitsFree and fitsFree_iff, reading the sites of a relation and the two trigrams as contexts.
  - Output: What contexts show glues exactly where they agree where they meet; a frame of context-free claims fits exactly where it glues everywhere; the indexed frame always fits.
  - Input: atSites for each relation, halves for the trigrams, home the height itself.
  - Preserved conditions: Every context lies within its home (trivially, within is True). [Context.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Context.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [generalization-through-lumping](generalization-through-lumping.md). Reuses Learning.Lumped and Learning.goAlike_iff_lumped for the oppositions and the count in phase under waxWane.
  - Output: A reading the law goes alike across exactly where it is a lumping.
  - Input: opposition and phaseCount under waxWane.
  - Preserved conditions: None. [Learning.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Learning.lean)
- related, not a proved adapter: [gluing-under-parity](gluing-under-parity.md). Another case of contexts that glue or do not; here every reading is decided and the failure to glue is located at the opposed heights.
- related, not a proved adapter: [hexagram-world-laws](hexagram-world-laws.md). The nuclear law, the cast, the four symmetries, the counter and the six orbits of waxing and waning on the same configurations, using the rises and falls for the changes around.
- related, not a proved adapter: [fixed-places-and-sole-lines](fixed-places-and-sole-lines.md). 王弼's second relation of phase on places 2 to 5 beside inPhase, under which 需's top line agrees, and the line answered by all others.
